title: The Internal Modal Logic of Forcing
summary: We connect modal set theory with Boolean-valued models by developing an \emph{internal} Kripke semantics for modal formulas whose atomic propositions are set-theoretic sentences. Given a complete Boolean algebra $B$, we view its elements as ``local perspectives on truth'' inside the Boolean-valued universe $V^{(B)}$ and interpret the modal operators using an accessibility relation $R$ on $B$ defined by \emph{co-consistency} (equivalently, Boolean compatibility): $aRb$ iff $a\wedge b\neq 0$.
